title: Dragons of Tarkir: card flavor text

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The Spirit Dragon, who slept for centuries in a cocoon of stone and magic created by Sarkhan and was stricken while Nicol Bolas moved unchallenged among the planes.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker (character) who created a cocoon around Ugin, saved Ugin in Tarkir's past, and returned to Tarkir's present.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker (character) who moved unchallenged among the planes while Ugin slumbered.

entities.name: Anafenza
entities.description: Martyred for worshipping her ancestors; executed under Dromoka's rule.

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: A dragonlord who rules the Shifting Wastes from the Great Aerie atop Arashin, served by humans and scalelords.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: A dragonlord whose words are translated from Draconic for his students, favoring Cori Stronghold.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: A dragonlord who supplanted the Sultai and dominates his clan from a fortress on the Marang River.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: A dragonlord with no lasting home whose army rushes from kill to kill.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: A dragonlord worshipped and fed at Ayagor, who conquered Qadat, the Fire Rim.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A Jeskai character who questions Ojutai's knowledge and studies lost clan names.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A planeswalker (character) who speaks of seclusion.

entities.name: Zurgo
entities.description: An old foe of Sarkhan who has become lowly.

entities.name: Kneecleaver
entities.description: A character driven by the Crave.

entities.name: Surrak
entities.description: The Hunt Caller, who serves Atarka.

entities.name: Sultai
entities.description: A clan that no longer exists after Silumgar supplanted it.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: A former clan whose ancestor trees are cut by the Dromoka.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane whose future was changed when Sarkhan saved Ugin in its past.

entities.name: Arashin
entities.description: The central city of the Shifting Wastes.

entities.name: Ayagor
entities.description: Where Atarka is worshipped and fed.

entities.name: Khanfall
entities.description: The time when the dragons came to rule Tarkir and its people aligned themselves with the five dragonlords.

events.summary: Ugin sleeps for centuries in a cocoon of stone and magic that Sarkhan made from a shard of a Zendikari hedron.
events.quote: For hundreds of years Ugin slept, encased in the cocoon of stone and magic Sarkhan had created using a shard of a Zendikari hedron.

events.summary: Anafenza is executed for worshipping her ancestors, though many secretly keep to the old ways.
events.quote: Even after Anafenza was executed, many secretly maintained their beliefs in the old ways.

events.summary: Sarkhan saves Ugin in Tarkir's past, changing the future so that the Sultai no longer exist and Silumgar and his clan supplant them.
events.quote: When Sarkhan saved Ugin in Tarkir's past, it changed Tarkir's future.

events.summary: A misthoof kirin heralds Sarkhan's return to Tarkir's present.
events.quote: It heralded Sarkhan's return to Tarkir's present.

events.summary: Sarkhan is eager to take vengeance on Zurgo until he sees how lowly his old foe has become.
events.quote: Sarkhan was eager to take vengeance on Zurgo until he saw how lowly his old foe had become.

events.summary: Atarka conquers Qadat, the Fire Rim, winning over its efreet with a promise to spread the glory of fire.
events.quote: Atarka conquered Qadat, the Fire Rim, long ago, winning over its efreet with a promise to spread the glory of fire to all the world.

events.summary: A shaman opens the earth and traps survivors in the crevices of Ayagor for Atarka to devour.
events.quote: The shaman opened the earth beneath their feet, trapping the survivors within the crevices of Ayagor for Atarka to devour at her leisure.

events.summary: Sarkhan gazes on dragons sweeping through the skies and joy kindles in his soul.
events.quote: Sarkhan gazed on the world around him, the dragons sweeping through its skies, and joy kindled like a fire in his soul.

events.summary: A mocking laughter echoes in Ugin's mind as he recalls his slumber while Nicol Bolas moved unchallenged.
events.quote: A mocking laughter echoed in Ugin's mind.

events.summary: Idols are forged in the Khanfall, when the dragons came to rule Tarkir.
events.quote: The idols were forged during the time of the Khanfall, when the dragons came to rule Tarkir and its people aligned themselves with the five dragonlords.

relations.quote: encased in the cocoon of stone and magic Sarkhan had created using a shard of a Zendikari hedron

relations.note: supplanted the Sultai in the changed timeline
relations.quote: The Sultai no longer exist, having been supplanted by the dragonlord Silumgar and his clan.
The most profound secrets lie in the darkest places of the world.
Lord Silumgar has given you a second chance to please him.
There is elegance in all the Ojutai do

relations.note: rules her clan from the Great Aerie
relations.quote: Dromoka rules her clan from the Great Aerie atop Arashin, the central city of the Shifting Wastes.
The Ojutai are my favorite victims.
